reason: Tenant reports a persistent burning smell and warmth at a kitchen socket (event-001, event-017, event-025), with a 10-year-old child at home (event-004). The case treats this as a reported electrical fire risk, so it is P0 until verified. Nothing has been inspected or isolated. The landlord's handyman has no electrical competence or test equipment (event-011, event-015) and did not enter (event-023). The landlord has authorised only a look-and-report visit and has not answered the authority and electrician request since 15:02 (event-016, event-020, event-024). The agency cannot approve spend, and waiting or chasing again would leave the hazard open, so a person on call must decide on an emergency electrician. The file note records that no emergency guidance had reached the tenant (event-009, event-025). I have staged safety advice to the tenant now, since urgent_by_code is true. This covers not using the socket, leaving and calling 999 if smoke, sparks or a stronger smell appear, and not opening the socket. The decision would change if the landlord approves an electrician or the tenant reports the hazard has resolved.

request: There is a hot smell near the kitchen socket by the counter, and the socket face feels warm. Please arrange an inspection. I am not sure whether the socket is safe to use.

actions.body: Hi Nora, thank you for the update. A warm socket with a burning smell can be an electrical fire risk, so please: keep everything unplugged from that socket and do not use it. Do not touch the socket face or try to open it. If you see smoke or sparks, hear buzzing or crackling, or the smell gets stronger, leave the property with your son straight away and call 999. If you can see a consumer unit switch clearly labelled for the kitchen or sockets and can reach it safely with dry hands, you may switch that one off, but do not open anything or guess at breakers. If the fridge is affected, move any essentials to a cooler place. We have passed this to our on-call team as urgent and will update you as soon as we have an electrician or inspection arranged. Maya Chen, Northbridge Lettings
actions.note: Recorded in the local outbox (no external delivery connected).
